name: Fujimura Manami
source:
Breasts that sway only by walking, slender but well-built limbs.
No doubt that this impudent and radical behaviour, like hitting protagonist, Kenji, right into the face the second she first saw him, will urge every man to sexually train her.
While being such a violent person on the one side, she also has the other side of her personality, being capable of frankly accepting a partner...
Will Kenji's view of life dramatically change being caught in such a strong personality?
